name: Dai (Sky Protocol)

regulatory_status.framework: N/A — decentralized protocol, no financial services license
regulatory_status.status: Sky (Skybase International) states it is not a broker, dealer, exchange, investment adviser, custodian, or financial service provider of any kind, and explicitly flags ongoing regulatory uncertainty across jurisdictions rather than claiming any license.

description: A decentralized, crypto-collateralized stablecoin (CDP-based) managed by Sky. Reserves are transparent on public on-chain dashboards (e.g. daistats.com, makerburn.com) rather than third-party attested. Sky is migrating holders to a successor token, USDS, which surpassed DAI in market cap during 2026; DAI remains live and redeemable 1:1 via the SkyMoneyConverter and Peg Stability Module.
